name: Power Fist
blurb: Active:  Blitzcrank charges up a fist to make the next  basic attack deal double damage and  knock up the target into the air.

effects.description: Active: Blitzcrank empowers their next basic attack within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, deal 100% AD (+ 25% AP) bonus physical damage and knock up the target for 1 second. This damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.
Power Fist resets Blitzcrank's basic attack timer.

notes:
Power Fist deals  basic damage, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as  spell damage.
This includes the  basic attack itself.
 Spell shield prevents the  knockup and the damage, including the damage of the basic attack itself.(unexpected)
The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become  untargetable during the attack's windup.
The knockup does not trigger against  structures, jungle plants, and  wards.
The Power Fist buff does not get consumed if the knockup doesn't trigger, allowing Blitzcrank to repeatedly attack structures for bonus damage.(unexpected)
The target is displaced a short distance during the  knockup in a random direction.
